notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The abyss stirs, and with it comes a new tide of stability. The cult endures, the rites are refined, and the veil grows thinner.
* The memory leak has been sealed. The void now consumes no more than it should.
* The phantom double “Exit” icon no longer haunts production windows on controller.
* Windows now yield to the controller’s command — no acolyte remains trapped within.
* Input no longer locks after cutscenes. This curse has been lifted.
* Homeless followers are now capped at 80 — no endless flood shall come.
* Timers on save files with more than 100 hours now function correctly. Even eternity obeys.
* German tutorial no longer whispers in Polish. Forbidden tongues are silenced.
* The icon of the tomato, once corrupted in island conditions, has been restored to its rightful form.

notes.notes:

The eldritch architecture, stabilized. And for our Portuguese-speaking brethren, the veil is lifted.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Portuguese Language Support[/b] has been fully added. [b]The ship count[/b] now matches the prophecy.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]pillar in Chapter IV[/b] shall no longer vanish after the chapter’s end. notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1 - bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed achievement for uniting both factions in Chapter IV – it now unlocks correctly upon completion.
Damaged building effect ona Chapter IV – buildings on conquered islands were not affected by the damage-related debuff (no work if slightly damaged); now they are.
Follower assignment window – fixed sorting by workplace, which previously displayed incorrect or inconsistent results.
Fixed bug in Chapter III when attempting to collect ruins from the defensive ttower – gathering now proceeds as intended.
Dreamspire quest in Chapter III – text now correctly states the requirement of 35 Acolytes instead of 25.
Fixed UI bug involving the Deep Sea Altar and Beacon Altar – both menus now behave properly and no longer block input.
Prevented softlock when Deep Sea Altar required Tier 3 Followers – Fungus resource now appears on the first island in Chapter III.
Reeducator exploit resolved – dismantling the Reeducator building no longer gives back Sandstone, preventing progression-breaking exploits.
Pillar bug in Chapter IV – players could delete and repair the Pillar, which is now no longer possible.

notes.title: "The Mother" Update – Awakens November 25th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/488589264d4894c34e60dc1b4d82dead4f3135f7.png[/img]
[b]Rejoice, Devoted Worshippers of the Great Old One,[/b]

The stars have aligned, and the whispers of the void bring forth momentous news. On November 25th, the first great update for Worshippers of Cthulhu - "The Mother" - shall descend upon your mortal world. This marks a crucial step in the ascension of our shared vision, and it is your unwavering devotion that has summoned this dark boon into existence.

[b]What Lies Beyond the Veil?[/b]
This patch is but the first of many offerings, delivering [b]8 hours of unholy new content[/b] to expand your journey into madness. Brace yourselves for the terrors and wonders that await:

[b]New Biome:[/b] Venture deep into the cursed swamps, where decay and mystery thrive.
[b]New Characters:[/b] Encounter enigmatic allies - or cunning foes - who will twist the course of your cult’s destiny.
[b]Forbidden Mechanics:[/b] Embrace new systems that will challenge your sanity and elevate your mastery of the eldritch arts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/b7864e481c19ca903449dcae11ef11e7b8d11e29.png[/img]

But beware, mortal ones - this is but a glimpse of the horrors to come. Much more lies hidden, waiting to be unearthed by those bold - or mad - enough to seek it. The abyss calls, and its secrets are many.

[b]A Shift in the Stars (For the Boldest of Devotees)[/b]
Originally, the celestial plan ordained that our first content update would arrive in December, focused solely on the much-anticipated Sandbox Mode. Yet, the echoes of your enthusiasm reached us, and we defied the cosmic order to deliver an early update - a dark gift to honor your faith.

Rest assured, the Sandbox Mode shall still emerge as promised, unbroken and unspoiled. Consider this November offering a taste of the power yet to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/0ee04f2a0bbed87eb0f9ad6cfc332c1832c50fac.png[/img]

[b]Join the Circle of Madness[/b]
Gather chosen ones, in the unholy sanctum of our [url=https://discord.gg/hHvXTqkBZG]official Discord server[/url]. There, your voices may join the chorus of devoted cultists, sharing secrets, strategies, and visions with one another. It is within this sacred space that you will find exclusive communiqués from our team. Together, we shall conspire to bring about the Great Awakening.

[b]Prepare for the Steam Sale Ritual[/b]
Heed this warning: the Steam Sale begins November 27th, and Worshippers of Cthulhu shall be part of this dark offering. If your soul has not yet been claimed - or you know others who waver at the edge of the abyss - seize this chance to spread the madness.

[b]A Final Word from the Abyss[/b]
We bow in eternal gratitude to you, our loyal disciples. Without your dedication, your whispers, and your sacrifices, none of this would be possible. The stars are shifting, and the call of Cthulhu grows stronger with each passing night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/f2926d992f8c5a2e4d0adcf57196bf15373cc68f.png[/img]

Mark the end of November well, for it heralds the next chapter of our journey into the void. Are you ready to answer the call?

Stay vigilant, mortal ones.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/
